scope: Invariant-theory compatibility of an odd p response with connected split-D7 symmetry versus the unowned disconnected outer sign quotient.

symmetry_fork.connected_group: W(D7) preserves p, so epsilon p is a connected invariant for scalar epsilon
symmetry_fork.fixed_scalar_effect: epsilon p changes sign under sigma for nonzero invariant epsilon
symmetry_fork.outer_gauged_consequence: a fixed-scalar odd p term is forbidden if the disconnected parity is gauged
symmetry_fork.connected_only_consequence: an odd p term is mathematically allowed but its coefficient and physical interpretation still require action ownership
symmetry_fork.spurion_option: covariance can be restored by assigning sigma(epsilon)=-epsilon, but choosing nonzero epsilon then adds an orientation-breaking datum
symmetry_fork.one_component_option: a physical one-component restriction can select a sign without an odd potential, but no such source-owned restriction is supplied

claim_ceiling: Exact symmetry-compatibility fork only. Connected invariance permits but does not derive an odd response; disconnected gauging forbids a fixed-scalar odd term but is itself unowned.
